lead.headline: CYCLONE ARNAB: CENTRE MOBILISES FOR ANDHRA LANDALL
lead.deck: Very severe storm forecast to cross the coast on October 28; rescue teams stand by across five states

image.alt: Satellite image of Cyclone Arnab over the Bay of Bengal on October 26, 2026
image.caption: CYCLONE ARNAB: NOAA-20 satellite imagery shows the storm over the Bay of Bengal on October 26. (Public domain / NOAA via Wikimedia Commons)

paragraphs: The Centre has put disaster-response teams on standby as Cyclone Arnab tracks toward the Andhra Pradesh coast, with landfall forecast between Bapatla and Visakhapatnam by the forenoon of October 28.

The India Meteorological Department forecast a very severe cyclonic storm with sustained winds of 115–125 km/h and gusts up to 140 km/h. Andhra Pradesh, Odisha, Telangana, Chhattisgarh and Puducherry have activated preparedness measures.

NDRF and state response teams are positioned, shelters and district control rooms are ready, and fishermen have been advised to stay ashore through October 29. Eastern Uttar Pradesh and Bihar have also been alerted for heavy rainfall.

sidebarStory.headline: BENGALURU METRO DROPS DOUBLE-DECKER PROJECT
sidebarStory.subhead: Centre rejects 44.65-km corridor; BMRL shifts focus to flyovers and tunnels
paragraphs: The proposed double-decker Metro corridor from J.P. Nagar 4th Stage to Kempegowda International Airport has been cancelled after the Centre declined approval. BMRL will focus on flyovers and tunnel roads instead.

stories.headline: NEWLYWED COUPLE KILLED IN E-SCOOTER CRASH
stories.subhead: A car rammed their scooter near Bengaluru, according to local reports
paragraphs: A newly married couple died after a car rammed their e-scooter near Bengaluru. The incident has renewed attention on road safety for two-wheeler riders.

stories.headline: SUPREME COURT ORDERS LAND RETURN IN BENGALURU
stories.subhead: Acquisition of about 59 acres in Nelakadiranahalli set aside
paragraphs: The Supreme Court quashed the decades-old acquisition process for roughly 59 acres and 39 guntas in Nelakadiranahalli and ordered the land returned.

stories.headline: BRIGADE HOTEL VENTURES REPORTS 105% PROFIT GROWTH

paragraphs: Brigade Hotel Ventures reported a 105% increase in profit after tax in the September quarter, with revenue of ₹142 crore.

stories.headline: CENTRE PUTS RESPONSE TEAMS ON STANDBY AS ARNAB NEARS
stories.deck: Andhra, Odisha and three other states prepare for heavy rain and high winds

image.alt: Satellite image of Cyclone Arnab over the Bay of Bengal
image.caption: Cyclone Arnab over the Bay of Bengal on October 26. (NOAA-20 / Public domain)

paragraphs: The National Crisis Management Committee reviewed preparations for Cyclone Arnab, forecast to cross the Andhra Pradesh and Yanam coasts between Bapatla and Visakhapatnam on October 28.

NDRF teams are deployed or on standby, while state authorities have arranged shelters and activated control rooms. Heavy rainfall alerts also extend to Telangana, southern Odisha, Chhattisgarh, eastern Uttar Pradesh and Bihar.

stories.headline: MODI WARNS OF CYBER TERRORISM THREAT
paragraphs: At the opening of the RBI’s data centre and cybersecurity training institute in Bhubaneswar, Prime Minister Narendra Modi said modern conflicts also target banking systems and digital infrastructure.

stories.headline: ARMY REJECTS VIDEO CLAIMING CHINESE CONTROL
paragraphs: The Indian Army has refuted a circulating video that falsely claimed Chinese control over border areas in Arunachal Pradesh, according to the day’s national news brief.

stories.headline: NEWLYWED COUPLE DIE AFTER CAR HITS E-SCOOTER
stories.deck: The fatal crash near Bengaluru has renewed concern over two-wheeler safety
paragraphs: A newlywed couple were killed when a car rammed their e-scooter near Bengaluru. The brief local report did not provide further details about the circumstances of the collision.

stories.headline: JW MARRIOTT BENGALURU CHANGES HANDS
paragraphs: Shree Naman Group acquired JW Marriott Bengaluru, while Brigade Group plans to open two new Hyatt Regency hotels in the city.

stories.headline: SIX PROJECTS RETENDERED AS COST RISES ₹16 CRORE
paragraphs: Bengaluru Smart Infrastructure Ltd has retendered six projects, with the revised cost rising by ₹16 crore, according to local coverage.

stories.headline: ARNAB FORECAST TO BRING WINDS UP TO 140 KM/H
stories.deck: Coastal communities urged to follow official alerts as the storm approaches
paragraphs: The IMD forecast sustained winds of 115–125 km/h, with gusts up to 140 km/h, as Cyclone Arnab approaches the Andhra coast. Authorities have advised fishermen not to venture to sea through October 29.

stories.headline: VIRAL FEVER AND DENGUE RISE AMONG CHILDREN
paragraphs: Local reporting says changing weather in Bengaluru is coinciding with an increase in viral fever and dengue among children.
